related.title: Node.js Streams：背壓與有界緩衝
related.titleEn: Node.js Streams: backpressure and bounded buffers
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付row-identity.csv、插入刪除與逆序的互動紀錄。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver row-identity.csv and traces for insertion, deletion and reversal.
related.difference: 建立每秒produced、consumed、queued計數；再於實際Writable中尊重false與drain。
related.differenceEn: Track produced, consumed and queued counts each second, then respect false anddrain in an actual Writable.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice:
穩定key把元件身分連到資料項目；以索引替代身分時插入或刪除可能讓輸入狀態跟錯項目。
教學基準：4-1 = 3 items；對照：3+1 = 4 items。

write回傳false表示應等待drain，不是寫入失敗；highWaterMark是停止繼續推送的門檻而非絕對記憶體硬上限。
教學基準：(100-60)*5*4 = 800 KiB_growth；對照：(60-60)*5*4 = 0 KiB_growth。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn:
Stable keys associate component identity with data items; index-based identity can attach input state to the wrong item after insertion or deletion.
Teaching baseline: 4-1 = 3 items; comparison: 3+1 = 4 items.

A falsewrite return means wait fordrain, not write failure; highWaterMark is a backpressure threshold rather than an absolute memory cap.
Teaching baseline: (100-60)*5*4 = 800 KiB_growth; comparison: (60-60)*5*4 = 0 KiB_growth.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Ninja：動態相依與dirty傳播
related.titleEn: Ninja: discovered dependencies and dirty propagation
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付row-identity.csv、插入刪除與逆序的互動紀錄。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver row-identity.csv and traces for insertion, deletion and reversal.
related.difference: 用小型生成器輸出build.ninja，記錄每個edge輸入/輸出與command hash，先完整建置。
related.differenceEn: Emitbuild.ninja with a small generator, record edge inputs/outputs and command hashes, and perform a full build.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice:
穩定key把元件身分連到資料項目；以索引替代身分時插入或刪除可能讓輸入狀態跟錯項目。
教學基準：4-1 = 3 items；對照：3+1 = 4 items。

Ninja執行明確建置圖，depfile或dyndep補足發現的相依；dirty狀態必須沿受影響edge傳播。
教學基準：4+1 = 5 edges；對照：5-1 = 4 edges。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn:
Stable keys associate component identity with data items; index-based identity can attach input state to the wrong item after insertion or deletion.
Teaching baseline: 4-1 = 3 items; comparison: 3+1 = 4 items.

Ninja executes an explicit graph; depfiles or dyndep supply discovered dependencies and dirty state propagates through affected edges.
Teaching baseline: 4+1 = 5 edges; comparison: 5-1 = 4 edges.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
